description:
Readable summary (crdr_signal.summarytext) from the collected summary, which is HTML for Message Center posts and blog items. Plain string steps only (no XML), so malformed HTML can't make it fail: raw newlines become spaces;

, , , , to and
become line breaks;
  • becomes a bullet; remaining tags are removed; common entities are decoded (& last); runs of spaces collapse, spaces around line breaks go, more than one blank line collapses; the result is trimmed. The engine (ChangeRadar.Text.psm1) and the flow run the same steps.

cases.note: Message Center post: bold heading, link,  , paragraphs
cases.html:
[What and why:]

To expand model choice in Copilot, Microsoft will make Claude models from Anthropic available by default for tenants in the United Kingdom (UK) on December 9, 2026. 

We’re also simplifying the controls.

cases.note: Whitespace: raw newlines are spaces; runs collapse; no spaces around line breaks
Empty paragraphs leave at most one blank line
A bare '<' in text (not escaped) is treated as a tag start: documented limitation; Microsoft escapes it as <
Numeric entities WordPress feeds use (the Power Platform blog, 2026-11-22): curly quotes, dashes, ellipsis, non-breaking space; & is an ampersand and, like &, is decoded last
